characters.name: KAIEN
characters.description: Quiet, observant, and grounded. Kaien operates in the urban underground of the CODEV2E universe, uncovering forgotten anomaly systems with calculated precision.

characters.name: LILITH
characters.description: Fierce, quick-witted, and relentless in combat. Recognized by her signature magenta hair streak and duelist glove, Lilith leads offensive breakthroughs in high-threat sectors.

characters.name: REN
characters.description: The strategic core of the team. Specializes in decrypting synthetic signal architectures and long-range tactical surveillance.

characters.name: AERIS
characters.description: A high-reflex dimensional pilot capable of traversing unstable narrative drifts between core sectors.

characters.name: ZERO-X
characters.description: An enigmatic enforcer engineered during the early foundation era. His true allegiances remain locked behind encrypted firewalls.
